subject: Commercial mechanism for Embark integration & intro rights
messages:
From: Lukas Meyer <lukas_meyer@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Wu <samantha@embarksys.com>
Cc: MonIca Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 10 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Commercial mechanism for Embark integration & intro rights

Hi Samantha —

Really enjoyed the demo yesterday. Per our conversation, I sketched a couple of commercial options for how we can work together on the Embark connector:

- Referral model: Embark registers a prospect in a 60-day window and receives a 10% referral credit on first-year net revenue; Redwood owns billing and support.
- Resale (white-labelled): Embark resells Redwood under a reseller margin model (20% margin), handles billing and first-tier support; Redwood provides onboarding playbook and preferred pricing for committed pilots.

Open questions for your side:
1) Would Embark require exclusivity for any verticals?
2) What lead registration evidence do you expect (HubSpot record id + intro email thread is fine for us)?
3) Do you have legal constraints for co-marketing mentions or use of Embark logo?

I attached a quick mutual action plan and a commission matrix for the two options to make it concrete. My suggested pilot pathway is: three co-sell-enabled trials (90 days each), with conversion credits if they convert to paid within 180 days.

Action requested: can you confirm which commercial path you prefer and whether your legal team wants to use your MSA or Redwood's reseller addendum?

Thanks —
Lukas Meyer
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
lukas_meyer@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0132

Attachments: Embark_Mutual_Action_Plan_v2.docx, commission_matrix_embark.xlsx

From: Samantha Wu <samantha@embarksys.com>
To: Lukas Meyer <lukas_meyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Gregory Park <greg@embarksys.com>, Embark Legal <legal@embarksys.com>
Date: Mon, 13 Apr 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Commercial mechanism for Embark integration & intro rights

Hey Lukas —

Thanks for the clear options — this is helpful. A few quick clarifications from our side:

- We generally prefer referral for early-stage integrations unless there's commitment to revenue targets. Referral helps us get traction without upfront billing complexity.
- Lead registration evidence: we can provide the HubSpot record + the intro thread and a brief intake form; 60-day window sounds reasonable but can we consider 90 days for enterprise accounts?
- Co-marketing: Embark requires an approval step on each joint asset; we can share brand guidelines.

Two asks for Redwood:
1) Can you confirm who owns trial discounts (Embark or Redwood) and whether credits ladder with ARR?
2) For reseller option, can you share a sample reseller addendum and the invoicing cadence (monthly vs. net 30)?

Looping in Gregory for pricing/legal.

Best,
Samantha Wu
Head of ISV Partnerships, Embark Systems
samantha@embarksys.com

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Lukas Meyer <lukas_meyer@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Apr 2027 09:43:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Commercial mechanism for Embark integration & intro rights

Lukas / team —

Quick internal note after reviewing the matrix:
- Referral (10% FYR): acceptable for small-mid deals < $50k ARR. For > $50k ARR we should negotiate step-up to 12–15% or require joint-opportunity qualification.
- 90-day lead registration for enterprise seems fair, but we should codify "qualified lead" definition (e.g., named buyer, budget timeline, and POC date).
- Reseller margin at 20% is fine if Embark takes billing and first-tier support; we should include a clawback window of 12 months for refunds/cancellations.

Also: if Embark drives more than 10 deals in 12 months we should establish an accelerator commission or dedicated deal desk.

I attached a redline-ready reseller addendum we can share once legal gives the go-ahead.

-Ben
Director, Partner Ops
Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: reseller_addendum_redline.docx (internal)

From: Embark Legal <legal@embarksys.com>
To: Lukas Meyer <lukas_meyer@redwood.ai>, Samantha Wu <samantha@embarksys.com>
Date: Thu, 16 Apr 2027 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Commercial mechanism for Embark integration & intro rights

Lukas / Samantha —

Thanks for the summary. A couple of legal points from our side:
1) We can accept a 90-day registration window for enterprise deals provided the HubSpot record and intro email are captured prior to Redwood's first sales outreach.
2) We need to review Redwood's reseller addendum and propose any carve-outs for Embark's rebranded offering (particularly around liability and indemnity).
3) For referral credits we prefer a payable credit (invoice offset) rather than a percentage rebate applied on Redwood's invoice — can you confirm how you operationalize credits?

Please share the actual reseller addendum and your standard credit memo flow.

Regards,
Embark Legal (on behalf of Gregory Park)
legal@embarksys.com

From: Lukas Meyer <lukas_meyer@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Wu <samantha@embarksys.com>, legal@embarksys.com
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 18 Apr 2027 15:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Commercial mechanism for Embark integration & intro rights

Samantha / Legal —

Great — appreciate the clarity. Proposed resolution so we can move to signature:

1) Pilot path (preferred): Start with referral model for first 3 co-sell trials. Credit structure: 10% referral credit on first-year net revenue, issued as a credit memo against Redwood invoices (applied within 60 days of invoice). For deals > $75k ARR, credit steps up to 15% if Embark provided the qualifying intro and supported the POC.

2) Enterprise registration window: 90 days for deals > $250k TCV; default 60 days for <$250k. Evidence required: HubSpot record id + earliest intro email to Redwood AE. Redwood will timestamp intake in our system to avoid disputes.

3) Reseller option remains available: 20% margin, reseller addendum applies, invoicing net 30, and a 12-month clawback for refunds. We'll provide the addendum redline and an implementation guide.

4) Co-marketing approvals: both parties to approve assets within 5 business days.

Next steps: I'll upload the redline addendum and commission matrix to the shared Drive and send a DocuSign for the pilot agreement. If you confirm, we'll aim to execute the pilot agreement by Apr 25 and stand up a shared HubSpot pipeline tag.

Thanks —
Lukas
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference

Attachments uploaded: commission_matrix_embark.xlsx
